# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

[Learn more][121]

## Happening at CVS Health®

### Here for women

Through our services, products, policies and partnerships, we're supporting the mental and physical
well-being of all women.

[Learn more about women's health][122]

## Investing in America’s health

### Creating a sustainable future

We’re helping shape a better world today, and for generations to come, through our impact
priorities.

[Understand our impact][123]

## Empowering future growth

### Living our purpose

We couldn’t be prouder of our colleagues that have made us the leading health care company.

[Learn more about our people ][124]

### Bring your heart to CVS Health

We are committed to building a workplace where every person is welcome, valued and can fulfill their
potential. Join us! 

[Explore career opportunities][125]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one

every minute matters.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

[Read more →][5]

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

[How we improved outcomes for patients around the world][104]

positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

Our strategy

curative medicines.

### APIs

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

focus on their core competencies.

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

Don’t miss your chance to make a generous gift to our 2026 Summer Annual Fund Drive to help fund
essential care and support as well as advance critical Alzheimer’s research.

[ Donate Now ][55]
[Walk to End Alzheimer's logo]


# Get Moving with Walk to End Alzheimer's

There's growing evidence that healthy habits like walking can help protect your brain for years to
come. Now is the perfect time to rally your coworkers, friends and family to start a Walk to End
Alzheimer's® team.

[ Register for Your Walk ][56]
[Family]

### Together, We Can
### End Alzheimer's

The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia — by
accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality
care and support.

**But we can't end Alzheimer's without your help.**

[Donate Now][57]

## [Everyday Actions. Lifelong Impact.][58]

Sign up for the (re)think your brain™ 6-Step Challenge for a guide to better brain health. Learn
healthy habits that can help you live better now and potentially lower your risk of dementia.
[Start the Challenge][59]

## [Get the Latest Dementia Research Updates][60]

Join us for AAIC For All: Community, a no-cost virtual event for members of the public to learn
about the latest findings in dementia research, straight from the experts themselves. Watch the
presentations live on July 16 or view the recordings afterward.
[Register for Free][61]

## [Turn Your Summer Fun into a Fundraiser][62]

Hosting a cookout, pickleball tournament or outdoor movie night? Make your event more meaningful by
adding a simple way to give back. Support Do What You Love to End ALZ™ by adding a suggested
donation or silent auction to an event you already have planned. 
[Get Started][63]

Understanding Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia

Alzheimer's is the most common form of dementia. It causes problems with memory, thinking and
behavior.

Talk to a dementia expert with our free 24/7 Helpline. Get confidential support, crisis assistance,
local resources and information in over 200 languages.

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

Don’t miss your chance to make a generous gift to our 2026 Summer Annual Fund Drive to help fund
essential care and support as well as advance critical Alzheimer’s research.

[ Donate Now ][55]
[Walk to End Alzheimer's logo]


# Get Moving with Walk to End Alzheimer's

There's growing evidence that healthy habits like walking can help protect your brain for years to
come. Now is the perfect time to rally your coworkers, friends and family to start a Walk to End
Alzheimer's® team.

[ Register for Your Walk ][56]
[Family]

### Together, We Can
### End Alzheimer's

The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia — by
accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality
care and support.

**But we can't end Alzheimer's without your help.**

[Donate Now][57]

## [Everyday Actions. Lifelong Impact.][58]

Sign up for the (re)think your brain™ 6-Step Challenge for a guide to better brain health. Learn
healthy habits that can help you live better now and potentially lower your risk of dementia.
[Start the Challenge][59]

## [Get the Latest Dementia Research Updates][60]

Join us for AAIC For All: Community, a no-cost virtual event for members of the public to learn
about the latest findings in dementia research, straight from the experts themselves. Watch the
presentations live on July 16 or view the recordings afterward.
[Register for Free][61]

## [Turn Your Summer Fun into a Fundraiser][62]

Hosting a cookout, pickleball tournament or outdoor movie night? Make your event more meaningful by
adding a simple way to give back. Support Do What You Love to End ALZ™ by adding a suggested
donation or silent auction to an event you already have planned. 
[Get Started][63]

Understanding Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia

Alzheimer's is the most common form of dementia. It causes problems with memory, thinking and
behavior.

* [Know the 10 Warning Signs][65]
* [Navigating Diagnosis][66]
* [Understanding the Stages][67]
* [Support for Caregivers][68]
* [Living With a Diagnosis][69]
* [Recursos en español][70]

Talk to a dementia expert with our free 24/7 Helpline. Get confidential support, crisis assistance,
local resources and information in over 200 languages.

**Call [800.272.3900][71]**
[Other ways to get help][72]

[Find Local Resources][75]
[An older Black man and his grandson speak with a female doctor about what causes Alzheimer's.]

Progress in research has created promising new treatments. Learn about which drugs are available so

[See Treatment Options][76]

voluntary health organization in Alzheimer's care, support and research.

support groups, education programs and more.

The Association is currently investing more than **$490 million** in over 1,220 active best-of-field
dementia projects in 59 countries, spanning six continents.

Our advocacy has increased the federal funding for Alzheimer's and dementia research to **$3.8

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make
better decisions

### and systems

review. [Read about our impact][23].

our evidence is trusted][24].

We produce outstanding evidence by collaborating with a wide range of experts and members of the
public. [Get involved][25].

# Statistics thatsave lives

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make
better decisions

### We change lives
### and systems

Two thirds of new World Health Organization guidelines in the past 5 years cite at least 1 Cochrane
review. [Read about our impact][23].

### Our evidence
### is trusted

Scientists, policymakers and decision-makers turn to us for evidence they can rely on. [Learn why
our evidence is trusted][24].

### We collaborate
### globally

We produce outstanding evidence by collaborating with a wide range of experts and members of the
public. [Get involved][25].

## [News][26]
* [ ][27]
  
  [Exercise helps hip arthritis pain, but perhaps less than we thought][28]
  
  23 July 2026
  
  A new Cochrane review finds that exercise may improve pain and function, but the benefits may fall
  short of what patients would notice in daily life.
* [ ][29]
  
  [Why evidence synthesis matters in the age of AI][30]
  
  22 July 2026
  
  In an era defined by an abundance of information, and new ways to find it, Cochrane’s Chief
  Executive Officer, Karla Soares-Weiser argues that systematic reviews remain an essential tool to
  help individuals, healthcare professionals and policymakers make decisions. However, the challenge
  is no longer simply producing reliable evidence but maintaining the trust that makes Cochrane’s
  evidence useful.
* [ ][31]
  
  [Building a volunteer network through Cochrane Engage][32]
  
  16 July 2026
  
  Knowledge translation (KT) is a key part of ensuring that high-quality evidence reaches the people
  who can use it. In Italy, however, research methods and evidence-based medicine (EBM) are not
  consistently integrated into higher education or medical education programmes.
* [ ][33]
  
  [World Evidence-based Healthcare Day launches its 2026 campaign][34]
  
  24 June 2026
  
  Today an international coalition of organizations dedicated to evidence-informed decision-making
  launched the World Evidence-based Healthcare Day 2026 campaign, ‘Evidence and AI: People at the
  Centre’.

## Explore the world of CPD

## CPD Explained

Modern society continues to develop in a time of rapid technological advancement, fast-changing
consumer needs and continuously adapting working environment.

CPD stands for Continuing Professional Development and is the term used to describe the learning
activities professionals engage in to develop and enhance their abilities. Continuing Professional
Development enables learning to become conscious and proactive, rather than passive and reactive.

[ What is CPD? ][101]

## Search for CPD

There is an increasing expectation for professionals to undertake Continuing Professional
Development regardless of industry sector, career level, job role and responsibilities.

CPD is a powerful learning tool to improve skills, ensure academic qualifications do not become
outdated, and take an empowering approach to career progression. Search for CPD courses, seminars,
events and providers.

[ Search for CPD ][102]
[CPD Stamp]

## CPD Accreditation for training and events

The CPD Certification Service helps organisations to structure their expertise into a clear approach
to learning. This structured learning can contribute towards professionals' CPD requirements.

CPD accreditation supports organisations in responding to evolving industry and learner
expectations. Organisations from a wide range of industry sectors use CPD accreditation to add value
to their training and events.

The CPD Certification Service provides accreditation for organisations ranging from small firms to
large training providers, multi-national corporations, conference & events organisers, universities,
further education colleges, local authorities, councils and Government departments. Contact our team
today to find out how to become an accredited CPD provider.

[ Become a CPD Provider ][103]
[Laptop]

## Record your CPD

It is important for all individuals to manage their Continuing Professional Development log
effectively on a regular basis.

The myCPD Portal is a powerful free online CPD record tool to help professionals to keep their
educational training log up to date.

Keep a track of training courses, workshops, seminars, eLearning, conferences and events that you
have attended throughout the year.

## What Healthcare Leaders Tell us

## Before They Switch

Neurologists Psychiatrists Health System Leaders Value-Based Care Leaders

### *“*I need cognitive assessment data I can act on. Not a single score that tells me what I
### already know.*”*

Traditional screeners like the MoCA and MMSE lack the sensitivity to detect mild cognitive
impairment across specific domains. They miss what your clinical judgment suspects but can't yet
document, whether it's early memory loss or subtle domain-specific decline.

[ For Neurologists ][76]

### "I need something more objective to complement what my patients tell me they're experiencing."

Patient-reported symptoms tell part of the story, especially for conditions like ADHD and mood
disorders. Knowing whether the problem is attention, memory, executive function, or all three tells
you more. And changes what you do next.

[ For Psychiatrists ][77]

### "Every site in our network tests cognition differently. Some don't test it at all."

Inconsistent protocols across primary care, neurology, and behavioral health mean patients are
tested differently depending on where they enter the system. Referral patterns are inefficient.
Documentation is incomplete.

[ For Health System Leaders ][78]

### "We're leaving HCC codes undocumented and RAF revenue on the table."

Cognitive conditions, including mild cognitive impairment and dementia, are among the most commonly
undercoded conditions in Medicare Advantage populations. Without systematic detection, you can't
document what you haven't measured.

[ For Value-Based Care Leaders ][79]

AI LEADER IN DIGITAL COGNITIVE ASSESSMENT

## AI is Only as Good as the Data Behind It

Creyos has been applying machine learning techniques to real clinical data since 2012 — so cognitive
test results are more accurate, not just more automated.

**NORMATIVE BENCHMARKING**

### **Benchmarks That Actually Reflect Your Patients**

Your patient is compared against the right reference population — not a generic cutoff. Creyos norms
draw from over 85,000 participants across age, education, cultural background, and language, so the
results mean something for the person sitting in front of you.

[Benchmark]

**LONGITUDINAL TRACKING **

### **Cognitive Trajectories, Not Just Snapshots**

One score tells you where a patient is today. A trajectory tells you where they're heading. Creyos
separates real cognitive change from normal test-to-test variation, so your care team knows whether
to act now or monitor over time.

[Tracking]

**CLINICAL INTELLIGENCE**

### **Results Ready When the Patient Is Still in the Room**

Reports generate the moment an assessment ends: task scores in plain language, performance flags,
and care pathway guidance. Structured for documentation, coded for reimbursement, built for your
EHR.

[Report-Jun-12-2026-05-12-01-8834-PM]

OUR TIMELINE. FROM DATA TO INTELLIGENCE.


### 1990s

fMRI and PET research maps cognitive domains to brain regions.

### 2012

Creyos brings cognitive assessment online, applying machine learning to clinical data at scale.

### 2017

Behavioral health questionnaires are added to the platform to enable more comprehensive evaluation.

### 2023

Creyos grows to support tens of thousands of clinicians and practices.

### 2025

20M+ tasks completed. One of the largest cognitive datasets in healthcare.

### 2026

Cognitive testing meets the age of AI, with decades of clinical data making every assessment more
accurate.

THE SCIENCE BEHIND CREYOS

## Born in the Lab. Not the Boardroom.

Chief Scientific Officer Adrian Owen built the foundational cognitive tasks across three decades at
Cambridge and Western University.

His work, cited over 82,000 times and published in Nature and Neuron, didn't get licensed to build
Creyos — it became Creyos. That scientific foundation is now validated across 400+ peer-reviewed
studies.

THE BUSINESS CASE FOR COGNITIVE ASSESSMENT

## Cognitive Assessment That Pays for Itself

### **HCC Coding and RAF Score Improvement**

Cognitive conditions like dementia carry significant HCC weight, but they're among the most commonly
undercoded in Medicare Advantage — because without systematic screening, you can't document what you
haven't measured. Creyos captures your patients' true risk.

### **CPT Reimbursement from Cognitive Testing**

The Creyos platform supports billing under common CPT codes for neuropsychological, psychological,
and cognitive services. For fee-for-service practices and health systems, that means reimbursable
revenue from assessment that's already part of your clinical encounter, just not yet captured.

### **Smarter Referrals, Lower Total Cost of Care**

When primary care physicians have objective cognitive data before referring, unnecessary specialist
appointments drop. That frees up capacity, reduces total cost of care, and shortens wait times for
the patients who need them most.

## See What Creyos Looks Like in Your Care Setting

## **Questions We Get Asked**

#### What is a cognitive assessment?

A cognitive assessment is a standardized evaluation of cognitive function across domains like
short-term memory, reasoning, and concentration. Unlike a brief screening, a cognitive assessment
measures cognitive ability and cognitive performance in enough detail to inform clinical decisions.
Creyos cognitive assessments are completed online, scored automatically, and validated across 400+
peer-reviewed studies.

#### How are Creyos cognitive tests different from the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) or
#### Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE)?

Traditional cognitive screening tools like the [Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)][85],
Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), clock drawing test, and Mini-Cog are designed to flag whether
further evaluation may be needed, but they offer limited detail on where cognitive function is
breaking down. The [MMSE][86] in particular has low sensitivity for mild cognitive impairment, and
briefer tools like the Mini-Cog and clock drawing test are not designed to differentiate between
specific domains. Creyos goes deeper, measuring cognitive performance across multiple domains with
the granularity to characterize the pattern of impairment — not just whether impairment is present.
Creyos is also self-administered, digitally scored, and available in multiple languages.

## Before They Switch

Neurologists Psychiatrists Health System Leaders Value-Based Care Leaders

### *“*I need cognitive assessment data I can act on. Not a single score that tells me what I
### already know.*”*

Traditional screeners like the MoCA and MMSE lack the sensitivity to detect mild cognitive
impairment across specific domains. They miss what your clinical judgment suspects but can't yet
document, whether it's early memory loss or subtle domain-specific decline.

[ For Neurologists ][76]

### "I need something more objective to complement what my patients tell me they're experiencing."

Patient-reported symptoms tell part of the story, especially for conditions like ADHD and mood
disorders. Knowing whether the problem is attention, memory, executive function, or all three tells
you more. And changes what you do next.

[ For Psychiatrists ][77]

### "Every site in our network tests cognition differently. Some don't test it at all."

Inconsistent protocols across primary care, neurology, and behavioral health mean patients are
tested differently depending on where they enter the system. Referral patterns are inefficient.
Documentation is incomplete.

[ For Health System Leaders ][78]

### "We're leaving HCC codes undocumented and RAF revenue on the table."

Cognitive conditions, including mild cognitive impairment and dementia, are among the most commonly
undercoded conditions in Medicare Advantage populations. Without systematic detection, you can't
document what you haven't measured.

[ For Value-Based Care Leaders ][79]

AI LEADER IN DIGITAL COGNITIVE ASSESSMENT

## AI is Only as Good as the Data Behind It

Creyos has been applying machine learning techniques to real clinical data since 2012 — so cognitive
test results are more accurate, not just more automated.

**NORMATIVE BENCHMARKING**

### **Benchmarks That Actually Reflect Your Patients**

Your patient is compared against the right reference population — not a generic cutoff. Creyos norms
draw from over 85,000 participants across age, education, cultural background, and language, so the
results mean something for the person sitting in front of you.

[Benchmark]

**LONGITUDINAL TRACKING **

### **Cognitive Trajectories, Not Just Snapshots**

One score tells you where a patient is today. A trajectory tells you where they're heading. Creyos
separates real cognitive change from normal test-to-test variation, so your care team knows whether
to act now or monitor over time.

[Tracking]

**CLINICAL INTELLIGENCE**

### **Results Ready When the Patient Is Still in the Room**

Reports generate the moment an assessment ends: task scores in plain language, performance flags,
and care pathway guidance. Structured for documentation, coded for reimbursement, built for your
EHR.

### **HCC Coding and RAF Score Improvement**

Cognitive conditions like dementia carry significant HCC weight, but they're among the most commonly
undercoded in Medicare Advantage — because without systematic screening, you can't document what you

### **CPT Reimbursement from Cognitive Testing**

The Creyos platform supports billing under common CPT codes for neuropsychological, psychological,
and cognitive services. For fee-for-service practices and health systems, that means reimbursable
revenue from assessment that's already part of your clinical encounter, just not yet captured.

### **Smarter Referrals, Lower Total Cost of Care**

When primary care physicians have objective cognitive data before referring, unnecessary specialist
appointments drop. That frees up capacity, reduces total cost of care, and shortens wait times for
the patients who need them most.

## **Questions We Get Asked**

#### What is a cognitive assessment?

A cognitive assessment is a standardized evaluation of cognitive function across domains like
short-term memory, reasoning, and concentration. Unlike a brief screening, a cognitive assessment
measures cognitive ability and cognitive performance in enough detail to inform clinical decisions.
Creyos cognitive assessments are completed online, scored automatically, and validated across 400+
peer-reviewed studies.

#### How are Creyos cognitive tests different from the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) or
#### Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE)?

Traditional cognitive screening tools like the [Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)][85],
Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), clock drawing test, and Mini-Cog are designed to flag whether
further evaluation may be needed, but they offer limited detail on where cognitive function is
breaking down. The [MMSE][86] in particular has low sensitivity for mild cognitive impairment, and
briefer tools like the Mini-Cog and clock drawing test are not designed to differentiate between
specific domains. Creyos goes deeper, measuring cognitive performance across multiple domains with
the granularity to characterize the pattern of impairment — not just whether impairment is present.
Creyos is also self-administered, digitally scored, and available in multiple languages.

### **A Singapore Dementia Story**

Through five short films by local filmmakers, A Singapore Dementia Story draws on the courage of
caregivers and the artistry of a team to illuminate the lived realities of those affected. Catch the
[full movie][110] today! 

To translate subtitles on YouTube videos, click the CC icon (or “closed captions” icon) to turn on
captions, then click the settings icon (gear icon), select English (auto-generated) and then select
“Auto-translate” to choose your desired language.

## Feel safe and supported with your digital dementia care companion

Get your CARA Membership today to access an ecosystem of personalised dementia support and benefits.

[blank]

## Get Support

Answer a few simple questions and get directed to caregiver schemes and service recommendations that
match your profile on SupportGoWhere.

[ Let’s Go ][112]

Your donation to Dementia Singapore will help us provide immediate resources and support for persons
living with dementia and caregivers, and to bolster our vital outreach programmes and services, as
well as our operations.

“Voice of Dementia Online” is a newsletter published by Dementia Singapore with news on events, tips
for caregivers, upcoming training workshops and medical news.

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself

reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

By the time it lands, it's old.

the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different

distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.

* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],

market-ready businesses.

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

Our strategic focus spans the pivotal therapeutic areas of Oncology, Dermatology, and Respiratory.
By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely

healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

### CAUTION NOTICE REGARDING FRAUDULENT RECRUITMENT

×

This is to notify to the public that certain unscrupulous persons, purporting to be part of and/or
being authorised by the human resources department of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited (“Glenmark”)
are fraudulently offering jobs via certain websites/or through telephone calls, SMS or fake letters
and asking the prospective job aspirants to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening
with Glenmark and/or to pay a fee for securing a job with Glenmark. We wish to caution the public
that Glenmark does not collect any monies or any other valuables as a pre or post-employment
requirement.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

# What is Iptor Unified Platform?

Iptor Unified Platform empowers distribution, warehousing, and manufacturing businesses with a
robust ERP solution. Built upon the proven DC1 ERP engine, it delivers a modern user experience,
flexible deployment choices (cloud or on-premise), and a thriving ecosystem of integrations. This
powerful combination streamlines operations, boosts efficiency, and drives significant business
growth. 

 

Our Mission is to provide businesses with a unified ERP solution that delivers measurable value by
driving growth, enhancing efficiency, and enabling them to adapt to the evolving needs of their
customers and the market. Our Vision is to lead the evolution of ERP for distribution, warehousing,
and manufacturing industries, delivering innovative solutions that drive operational excellence and
empower businesses to thrive in the digital age**.**

  seamless transitions between options
* **Enhanced User Experience**
  Customizable dashboards and mobile accessibility, combined with an intuitive interface, enhance
  user adoption and satisfaction
* **Scalable Growth**
  A modular architecture, combined with preconfigured processes and global regulatory management,
  enables businesses to adapt quickly to market changes
* **Robust Security and Compliance **
  24/7 surveillance, audit trails, and secure permissions ensure data protection and compliance with

Implementation time varies based on your specific needs, but our streamlined process and expert

Yes, our extensive API support and partner ecosystem allow for seamless integration with a wide

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Why Choose Home Care?

[Home care provides you with specialised care, continuity of care and cost effectiveness while you
can enjoy family support and the comfort of your own home]
**1. Specialised Care**
Our clinical team ensures you and your loved ones receive personalised care and tailored treatments
according to your needs and requirements.

**2. Continuity of Care**
Our team ensures that our medical professionals are aware of your medical needs – from doctors to
nurses to caregivers. We aim to provide wholesome care from one professional to another.

**3. Cost-Effective**
We try our best to provide you with cost-effective care options in comparison to long-term care in
nursing homes or hospitals.

**4. Family Support**
The presence of family support greatly enhances one’s mental and emotional well-being and
motivation, which can help your loved ones in their journey to recovery.

**5. Comfort **
Nothing beats the feeling of recuperating in the warmth and comfort at home. Your loved ones can
feel relaxed and at ease, without the buzz and commotion.

## Our Services
* ### Transitional Care
  
  Hospitalization often signals instability in a patient's condition. This often requires changes in
  the way patients and their families manage at home after discharge from hospital.
  
  Due to the changes in the patient's medical condition, care needs, etc. this is a highly stressful
  situation. **Ninkatec** can help to monitor patients' health after discharge and coordinate the
  care needed at home.
  
  ● Change in function after stroke, requiring tube feeding and nursing care
  ● Decompensation after hospitalization, requiring therapy and monitoring medications
  
  [Learn More][83]
* ### Palliative Care
  
  End of life care at home to manage symptoms and relieve suffering is a preferred option for some
  patients. This presents many challenges to patients and their families, and supporting them at
  home can be very helpful.
  
  Monitoring symptoms like pain or breathlessness, titrating medications, and engaging nursing care
  are some ways that Ninkatec can help.
  
  ● Terminal care for cancer
  ● End-stage kidney disease
  [Learn More][84]
* ### Nursing Care
  
  Your loved ones might require regular nursing care at home such as changing catheter bags,
  changing feeding tubes, or IV infusion in the comfort of your home. Ninkatec's experienced
  in-house nurse team is here to help you.
  [Learn More][85]
* ### Chronic Care
  
  For many chronic diseases, patients' conditions are often stable, experiencing occasional bouts of
  acute illnesses. During the stable phase of care, close monitoring of health status may preempt or
  warn about impending changes in the disease conditions.
  
  Ninkatec can help to monitor disease conditions so that we may detect deterioration of patients'
  health status. Depending on the severity of acute illnesses, some conditions can be treated at
  home. Ninkatec can help to coordinate the care and monitor progress of treatment.
  
  ● Parkinson's disease and swallowing impairment
  ● Chronic stroke and recurrent chest infections
  [Learn More][86]
* ### Dementia Care
  
  Dementia care is challenging because patients cannot properly explain their symptoms; behavioural
  and sleep problems can also make care for patients difficult.
  
  Ninkatec can help to monitor these symptoms and offer appropriate advice.
  [Learn More][87]
* ### Care Coordination
  
  Many patients have medical problems which are complex, requiring attention from multiple medical
  specialists and service providers. Ninkatec offers care coordination where we synchronize the
  delivery of healthcare to improve outcomes. 
  
  Through technology, we establish a link between patients and our team, and keep an open channel of
  communication with the patient’s family. In addition, our medical and health partners hail from
  diverse backgrounds, and together we seek to build a strong relationship with our patients and
  journey together to discover their care needs.
  [Learn More][88]
